"Success ka elevator nahi—stairs lena padega."
Success se mind peace milti hai.
Jahan ho, wahi se start karo.
Ya dukh manao, ya motivate ho jao.
Khud ko challenge karo.
Action motivation create karta.
Nikalne ka best raasta: through.
Success tumhare paas kya hai, usme nahi hai.
Oorja aur nirantar prayas hi sabhi cheezon par vijay paate hain.
Apne thoughts soch-samajh kar chuno, kyunki wahi tumhari life banenge.
Small start karo, but abhi start karo.
